prompt: A hyper-realistic image of a massive Canadian Mafia boss, fused with the powerful traits of a Polar Bear. The Mafia boss is towering and imposing, wearing a luxurious white fur coat made of polar bear fur, radiating both elegance and raw strength. His cold, piercing eyes, like frozen lakes, exude an air of dominance and calculation. His body is covered in intricate tattoos, depicting bears, wolves, and Canadian wildlife, symbolizing his unyielding nature. He holds a cane carved with a detailed maple leaf, a symbol of his heritage and power, while in his mouth dangles a lit cigar, releasing wisps of smoke into the air. Around his neck, a thick gold chain rests, adding a touch of opulence, and on his wrist, a high-end watch gleams. He stands confidently, surrounded by his loyal gang members, their expressions frozen in reverence and fear. The setting is a dark, urban alley with snow gently falling, the soft glow of streetlights reflecting off the wet pavement, emphasizing the cold, ruthless aura of the Mafia boss. The color scheme is dominated by whites, silvers, and dark, muted tones, creating an atmosphere of controlled power and chilling authority. --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
